PLAN "12-Week Integrated Strength, Nutrition, Cardio & Recovery (Meniscus Rehab)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Strength, weight maintenance, cardio fitness, mobility, and safe return to skiing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Integrated Programme" (12 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Body Strength":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          bicep_curl 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 2m
          shoulder_stretch 2m
      DAY Tuesday cardio 30m "Cardio Intervals (Bike/Elliptical)":
        modality:
          cycling 5m rpe 6
          cycling 10x(1m rpe 8, 1m rpe 5)
        notes "Alternate 1 minute hard (rpe 8) with 1 minute easy (rpe 5) for 10 rounds. Use elliptical if preferred."
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Body & Core Stability":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          step_up 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          bird_dog 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
      DAY Thursday recovery 20m "Full Body Mobility & Stretch":
        sequence:
          walking 5m rpe 4
          arm_circles 2x15
          wrist_circles 2x15
          cat_cow 2x10
          spinal_twist 1m
          back_stretch 1m
          chest_stretch 1m
          shoulder_stretch 1m
          neck_stretch 1m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body & Mobility":

          side_plank 3x20s rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
          superman 3x12 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          back_stretch 2m
      DAY Saturday cardio 35m "Mixed Cardio Endurance":

          rowing 5m rpe 6
          rowing 5x(2m rpe 7, 1m rpe 5)
